description: Keep the final reply in the user's conversational language, 2–4 short sentences (25–60 words): report the verified result and ask ONE relevant optional next-step question about ONE action, not a choice menu. Mandatory missing details take priority. Suggestions never perform actions automatically; respect requests for no suggestions. Saved links let friends join without accounts. If CURRENT received UI context or actual host evidence confirms the same saved plan and last-action module are already open, do not call open_planner again; realtime updates the existing view. Historic context is insufficient. Otherwise open the last-action module with the selected credentials, or honor an explicit opening request. Add exactly ONE independently checkable item to the shared checklist (e.g. "Bring the grill"). For several requested tasks, shopping items or recipe ingredients, call this tool separately for EACH item; never combine the list into one text. Keep quantities and explanatory details with their own item. Read get_checklist afterwards to verify separate item_ids. Acts as the participant. Service use restrictions: plan creation, participation and edits for users known to be under 13 (or a higher local minimum) are prohibited, including under a nickname. Personal data about known underage children, sensitive medical records, intimate content, card details, government IDs, passwords and verification codes are prohibited planning input. This tool covers ordinary non-sensitive group planning only.

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character id. Bare module links such as https://lesgooo.fun/when are local drafts: ask for a saved link, never substitute a previous plan ID.

text.description: One independently checkable item, single line, max 500 chars. Not a list of multiple tasks/ingredients.
